panels.title: Service Target Health
panels.description: 1 means Prometheus can scrape the target.

targets.expr: sum by (method, route, status) (rate(finance_http_server_requests_total{status=~"4..|5..",route!~"/actuator.*"}[5m])) or sum by (method, route, status) (rate(finance_http_server_requests_total_total{status=~"4..|5..",route!~"/actuator.*"}[5m]))
sum by (provider, operation, result) (rate(provider_request_total[5m])) or sum by (provider, operation, result) (rate(provider_request_total_total[5m]))
sum by (endpoint, result) (rate(dataservice_request_latency_seconds_sum[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint, result) (rate(dataservice_request_latency_seconds_count[5m])), 1)
sum by (endpoint, result) (rate(dataservice_request_latency_seconds_seconds_sum[5m])) / clamp_min(sum by (endpoint, result) (rate(dataservice_request_latency_seconds_seconds_count[5m])), 1)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, provider, operation, result) (rate(market_provider_latency_seconds_bucket{job="python-data-service"}[5m])))
